name: Teldrassil
summary: Off Kalimdor's northwest shore rises Teldrassil, the World Tree, and in its crown lies Darnassus. The druids raised it after the Third War. Yet its growing is troubled.

sections.title: A Canopy Upon the Sea
sections.body:
Vast are the limbs of Teldrassil, and far beneath them lies the Veiled Sea. Upon its boughs are hills and ancient glades, and misty lakes. Its rivers are fed by the morning dew. At the western edge stands Darnassus, city of the kaldorei.

Far below, at the foot of the trunk, lies Rut'theran Village. It is the island's harbor. And a gateway of enchantment joins it to the crown.

sections.title: The Refusal of the Aspects
sections.body:
In the Third War, Nordrassil was sacrificed. Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage passed into the Emerald Dream. In his absence, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm went before the Circle of Ancients. He prevailed upon them to grow another tree in its place. For he hoped to win back the undying life the kaldorei had lost.

But Nozdormu and the Dragon Aspects judged it a work of pride. They withheld their blessing. And so Teldrassil grew unwarded. With it grew flaws not of nature.

sections.title: A Creeping Malady
sections.body: Violence has spread among Teldrassil's wildlife. Peaceful furbolg tribes have fallen into madness, twisted grells multiply in the barrows, and satyrs perform dark rites in places such as Fel Rock. On Darkshore's shores, sea giants, threshers, and turtles beach themselves to escape the tainted waters around the tree. Naturalists and sentinels search the boughs for the shadow slowly strangling their new home.

faq.answer: After Nordrassil was devastated at the end of the Third War, the night elves lost their immortality. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm urged the Circle of Ancients and Cenarion druids to plant a new World Tree in the sea, hoping to restore what their people had lost.

faq.q: Why didn't Teldrassil restore night elf immortality?
faq.answer: Nozdormu, the Timeless One, blessed Nordrassil and granted the night elves immortality. When Teldrassil was raised, he judged their desire arrogant and refused to bless the new tree.

Go through Darnassus to the pink portal in the Temple Gardens, which carries you down to Rut'theran Village at the trunk's base. From there, take a ship across the sea to Auberdine on mainland Darkshore, or follow one of the available hippogryph routes.

faq.q: Why are there no mining nodes in Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Teldrassil grows from the living branches and wood of a colossal World Tree, not continental rock. Without stony subterranean crusts, the zone has no metal veins or ore deposits, though herbs grow in abundance.

faq.q: What is causing the furbolgs and beasts to turn mad?
faq.answer: A sinister presence is seeping into Teldrassil's unblessed roots, and sickness has tainted the local water and flora. It drives peaceful timberlings and the Gnarlpine furbolg tribe into aggression, while satyr remnants actively cultivate the taint.

Shadowglen is a sheltered vale on Teldrassil's eastern boughs, surrounding the great tree Aldrassil. Young night elves begin their training in this peaceful sanctuary before venturing into the wider world.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Teldrassil as your people's new beginning after Mount Hyjal's devastation. Without the Aspects' blessings, defending it is urgent.
With Malfurion trapped in the Emerald Dream, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the Cenarion Circle here. Many druids worry Teldrassil was raised in haste.
Teldrassil is the Alliance's northernmost stronghold in Kalimdor, supporting naval communication and trade between Darnassus and mainland kingdoms.
Teldrassil has no minerals or ore, but its canopy offers Peacebloom, Silverleaf, and Earthroot in abundance.
